entities.name: Ethernet header compression configuration
entities.description: Information element used to negotiate or re-negotiate Ethernet header compression configuration for a PDU session.

entities.name: UE wishes to re-negotiate Ethernet header compression
entities.description: Condition where UE wishes to re-negotiate Ethernet header compression configuration and both UE and network support Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization and Ethernet header compression.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE performs inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode to negotiate Ethernet header compression configuration.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization support
entities.description: Property indicating both UE and network support Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: Ethernet header compression support
entities.description: Property indicating both UE and network support Ethernet header compression.

relations.description: Condition where UE wishes to re-negotiate Ethernet header compression guards the inclusion of the IE.
Condition of inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode guards the inclusion of the IE.
Re-negotiation condition requires Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization support.
Re-negotiation condition requires Ethernet header compression support.
